mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. Have you ever wondered why, for so many of us, money feels tangled up with so much more than just numbers? Let’s be honest—money, power, and gender all weave together, shaping our stories and the world around us in ways we might not even notice at first. Together, we’re about to step into the world of Financial Feminist: Overcome the Patriarchy's Bullsh*t to Master Your Money and Build a Life You Love, brought to life by Tori Dunlap. This isn’t just another money guide. It’s a bold invitation to question the old rules—rules that have too often kept women from feeling secure, independent, or even heard when it comes to money. What if you could turn financial empowerment into your own quiet revolution? Along this journey, we’ll break down the walls—shifting from the “shoulds” and “can’ts” to practical strategies that truly fit your life. We’ll tackle everything from budgeting and investing, to finding your voice in negotiations, to building real, lasting wealth. But it’s more than spreadsheets or dollar signs. We’ll dive into the emotional side of money—the limiting beliefs, the stories we carry, and the ways community and collective action can spark real change. So, are you ready to rethink what’s possible? Let’s do this together—step by step, story by story—until you feel confident, clear, and free to build a life you truly love.
